req.title: Update unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-011 requires that PUT /tasks/{task_id} returns HTTP 404 when the task_id does not exist. To achieve high mutation kill rate we need: (1) a positive case confirming a real task CAN be updated (200 path), (2) a negative case confirming a non-existent id returns exactly 404 with the correct detail string, (3) a boundary case at task_id=0 (invalid/non-existent boundary), and additional cases testing id=1 after deletion (state transition) and a very large id. We assert exact status codes and exact JSON fields to catch operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_put_existing_task_returns_200
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ to obtain a valid task_id
actions: POST /tasks/ with title='Existing Task' to create a task
expected: Response JSON contains id matching the created task
trace: R-TASK-011: verifies the 2xx success path exists so 404 path is distinguishable
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r011_pos.db')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite:///./test_r011_pos.db', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_existing_task_returns_200():
    r_create = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Existing Task', 'description': None, 'completed': False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()['id']
    r_update = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': 'Updated Task'})
    assert r_update.status_code == 200
    body = r_update.json()
    assert body['id'] == task_id
    assert body['title'] == 'Updated Task'
    assert body['completed'] == False

expected: Response JSON detail contains the task id and 'not found'

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r011_stc.db')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from app.database import Base
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite:///./test_r011_stc.db', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_deleted_task_returns_404():
    r_create = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'To Delete', 'completed': False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()['id']
    r_delete = client.delete(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r_delete.status_code == 204
    r_update = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': 'Revived Task'})
    assert r_update.status_code == 404
    body = r_update.json()
    assert 'detail' in body
    assert str(task_id) in body['detail']
    assert 'not found' in body['detail'].lower()

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_nonexistent_does_not_return_200_or_201():
    payload = {'title': 'Full Payload', 'description': 'desc', 'completed': True}
    r = client.put('/tasks/42', json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 404
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 201
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert 'detail' in body
    assert body['detail'] != ''
    assert '42' in body['detail']
